title: docs(skills): the objectui action-block rule teaches variant 'danger' for a destructive action; destructive is the Button primitive's word
body:
Part of #27243 — this PR lands the teaching line and the changeset. The eval case the card also wants cannot be paid under `skills/objectui/evals/page-builder.json`'s ceiling by honest deletion (560 tokens, headroom 0; the case costs 124 tokens after every tightening), and the claim forbids a `CEILINGS` raise, so it waits for the seat's decision — Acceptance notes.
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:objectui 技能包 `rules/protocol.md` 的「Actions Are Node Types」规则新增一句:`"variant": "danger"` 让动作块变红并经由 destructive 确认按钮提问;`destructive` 是 Button 原语的词,写在动作块上保存时被拒。同文件删去两句他处已讲的话付账。一条 `@objectstack/skills` patch changeset。
- 为什么改:PR #26966 把动作块的 `variant` 从 `destructive` 改名 `danger`,但技能包没教过动作块的 `variant`;AI 作者只能从 React 示例里抄到 `destructive`,写到动作块上即被保存拒收。
- 风险与回滚:只改一份技能 markdown 与一条 changeset,不动 spec、运行时、评测数据;`rules/protocol.md` 4357 → 4366 / 4368,上限不动;回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`skills/objectui/rules/protocol.md`(新增段落 L275–L278;删去的两句原在 L139–L141 与 L161–L163,均为同文件他处已陈述的事实)。
- 两分钟验证:`node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`,预期见 `skills/objectui/rules/protocol.md 4366 / 4368 (-2)` 且末行为绿勾。
- 需要你做的:评测用例欠一个决定(见 Acceptance notes 第一条):按 2026-10-27 裁决「A:先削重复,余额按实测提高」把 `page-builder.json` 的上限抬 +124,或改走别的路;Tier H 技能面,席位复核后由维护者 APPROVED 落地。

## What changes

- `skills/objectui/rules/protocol.md`, rule "Actions Are Node Types, Not An Event Bag": one paragraph after the `action:button` example. `"variant": "danger"` draws the button red and asks its `confirmText` question through the destructive confirm button; `destructive` is the Button primitive's word (`variant="destructive"` on the React Button, which `guides/auth-permissions.md` L250 and `rules/composition.md` L143 already show); on an action block the spec refuses it at save, naming the rename.
- Paid in the same file, both deletions stated elsewhere in the file: the provenance sentence "The `dataSource` wiring this was first measured through is retired; the envelope readings below are unchanged by that" (the retirement is taught under "Rule: Data Binding Path Resolution", now L220–L229), and the closing restatement "What is *not* open: a `${...}` on the node is never evaluated, and a key under `props` never reaches a `ui:*` / `page:*` renderer at all" (both facts are the rule's own opening paragraph, L105–L111, and rows 2 and 4 of its table). No re-wrap counted as payment.
- `.changeset/27243-objectui-action-variant-eval.md`: `'@objectstack/skills': patch`, carrying both declaration lines.

Every claim in the line, against `origin/main` `72b08eec`:

| Claim | Source |
|:---|:---|
| the action blocks' `variant` enum is `default`, `danger`, `outline`, `secondary`, `ghost`, `link` (+ `primary` on `action:button`) | `packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts` L3451 `ACTION_BLOCK_VARIANTS`; L3944 `actionBlockVariant("An `action:button`'s", ['primary'])` |
| `destructive` is refused on an action block, with the rename | `component.zod.ts` L3460–L3463 `actionBlockVariant` error map keyed on `issue.input === 'destructive'`; L3472–L3477 `refuseActionBlockDestructiveVariant`; the protocol-18 entry `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.ui-page-action-block-variant-destructive-refused.ts` says where it is met: "the next save of the page meets the component-props gate at the metadata save door; `os validate` reports the old value as a `component-props-invalid` finding" |
| `danger` draws the destructive button and the confirm button destructive | `component.zod.ts` L3945 describe; `ui/packages/components/src/renderers/action/runner-variant.ts` `toButtonVariant` (`danger` → `destructive`) and `toRunnerVariant`; `ui/packages/components/src/renderers/action/action-button.tsx` L207–L209 and L330–L333; `ui/packages/core/src/actions/ActionRunner.ts` L551–L553 and L1611–L1613 (`confirmOptions`: a `danger` action paints the confirm button destructive) |

| the ADR-0087 D2 conversion rewrites stored rows | `packages/spec/src/conversions/registry.ts` L11547 `page-action-block-variant-destructive-to-danger`, `toMajor: 18` |

- `node ui/scripts/check-skill-eval-tokens.mjs` exits 0 before and after ("Every must_contain token is taught by its own skill bundle"). After this PR the bundle teaches `"variant": "danger"` and `confirmText` as whole tokens, which the pending eval case's `must_contain` needs.

## Acceptance notes

- **The eval case, measured and not landed.** Fixture: `skills/objectui/evals/page-builder.json` (it owns the action-block cases, 1 and 3; `protocol.json`'s diagnostic shape would put the refused spelling in the prompt and fail an answer that quotes it). The case: prompt "Add a 'Delete product' button to the product detail page. It must read as destructive and ask the user to confirm before the record is removed."; expected output names an `action:button` whose `properties` carry `label`, `actionType`, `target`, a `confirmText` question and `variant 'danger'`, red and confirming through the destructive confirm button, with the primitive's spelling refused on a block at save; `must_contain` `action:button`, `"variant": "danger"`, `confirmText`; `must_not_contain` `"variant": "destructive"` (a JSON key-value literal, so an answer that says `destructive` is the primitive's word, or shows `variant="destructive"` on the React Button, still passes; the expected output does not spell it). Cost: the file is 2238 bytes against a 2240-byte ceiling. With the case written lean (457 bytes of prose, 790 with its JSON frame) and every existing prompt and rubric tightened the way PR #27426 paid (every `must_contain` token and fact kept, 1206 → 914 bytes of prose), the file reads 2735 bytes = 684 tokens: **+124 over the ceiling**, and nothing left to delete without losing an assertion. The route the ratchet header records for this shape is the 2026-10-27 ruling 「A:先削重复,余额按实测提高」(decision card 「skills 修复卡的教学和 eval 都撞 token 天花板,怎么付?」), under which `CEILINGS` rows moved +160, +194, +224, +286 and +297 on 10-27/10-28 for evals that could not be paid down. The claim for this card forbids a raise, so the case is held: the drafted fixture is in the report on the card, ready for a patch round on this PR once the seat rules.
- **Out of scope, class b (contract text contradicts the schema), reach: release text.** `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.ui-page-action-block-variant-destructive-refused.ts` `reason` says "Other components that draw the Button primitive directly (`element:button` and the like) keep `destructive`". `ElementButtonPropsSchema.variant` (`component.zod.ts` L2968) is `primary | secondary | danger | ghost | link` — no `destructive` — and `ui/packages/components/src/renderers/basic/elements.tsx` L308–L314 maps `danger` → shadcn `destructive`. The card body repeats the same sentence ("`destructive` stays the word for the Button primitive (`element:button`)"). The entry's text is compiled into the upgrade guide (`gen:upgrade-guide`), so the wrong sentence ships. This PR's line says "the Button primitive's word (`variant="destructive"` in React)" and does not name `element:button`. Not fixed here; noted for the seat (dedupe words: `element:button destructive`, `upgrade guide variant`, `18.ui-page-action-block-variant-destructive-refused`).
- The commit's author field reads `marchtian` with the configured `noreply@anthropic.com` address: a `-c user.name` I passed on the commit by mistake (the worktree's configured `user.name` is `Claude`). An amend plus `--force-with-lease` was refused by the auto-mode classifier (Git Destructive) and not retried; the trailer pair is model-free and correct.
- Locally NOT MEASURED, prerequisites absent on an unbuilt tree, CI's Lint and Repo Gates run them built: `check:dts-closure`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:lean-entry-closure`, `check:sourcemap-no-sources-content` (exit 3: no `dist/` for most packages), `@objectstack/lint check:doc-formula-expressions` (exit 3: `@objectstack/formula` not built).
